decision: The hybrid addresses the measured vertex-only coarse-component bottleneck while retaining every mixed-weight face in the candidate domain. It is ready for the separate selector/component checks, not visual acceptance.
old_shortfall_resolution: Both previously saturated indexed components are entirely exact-uniform skin: authored torso and tail. Their nominal area shares can be sampled in triangle interiors without a source-vertex count ceiling.
remaining_required_evidence: The real selector must reproduce the exact named-vector classification and 1535/482, 527/0, 456/0 domain counts, without a positive influence cutoff, tolerance-based merge or fallback to another domain.

Preserve one explicit domain/source face or vertex record for each root. Uniform interior roots inherit the exact shared normalized named vector; varying anchors use the exact selected source vertex tuple.
Record selected coincident-position multiplicities. The varying coat has 56 paired UV seam aliases; unique indices alone do not promise spatially unique anchors.
Keep every eligible varying face in the sampling support; this does not require or prove one root on every triangle.

Actual motion/root attachment and unchanged-camera 720/256 image comparisons remain required. Check coarse torso/tail, all three materials and mixed-weight seam regions without reducing counts or quality thresholds.
scope: Read-only classification and capacity, not selected roots, generated geometry, native images, attachment verification, dense fur or Muse parity.
